process_area.title: Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics

value_stream.name: Field Retail Operations, Regional/District Management & Multi-Store Retail Execution Network

fields.Owner: Director Field Retail Operations / Store Ops (VS-07)
fields.Participants: Store Ops (VS-07), HR (VS-103), IT (VS-27), Finance (VS-17.4), functional SMEs (Merch/HR/Facilities/LP)

workflows.name: Store Operations Support Center (Store Hotline) Setup, Staffing & Operating Model

Automation Opportunity: - Demand-based staffing model; integrated ticketing; channel consolidation
Controls: - CTL-763 (ensure controlled execution — Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics (PA-177.3).)
- CTL-763: scope boundaries documented (not IT VS-27 / not HR VS-103); SLAs defined; leadership-approved (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT service desk — distinct), VS-103 (HR shared services — distinct), VS-63 (store comms — reverse direction); W5122 (escalation), W5127 (dashboard)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Scope-creep risk**: Becoming a duplicate IT/HR helpdesk; mitigated by clear scope boundaries & routing rules
- **Under-staffing risk**: Demand exceeds capacity → slow resolution; mitigated by demand-based staffing
- **Tool-proliferation risk**: Yet another system stores must use; mitigated by integration with existing channels (VS-63)
System Touchpoints: - Ticketing/case tool (new — distinct from VS-27 ITSM & VS-103 HR); store ops (VS-07); field dashboard (W5127); analytics (VS-28); governance (VS-36)

steps.a: Director Field Retail Operations / VP Store Operations
steps.activity: Design the support-center operating model: scope (operational issues, policy clarification, exception requests, cross-functional coordination — NOT IT-service-desk VS-27 nor HR-shared-services VS-103), channels (phone/hotline, chat, ticketing), hours, SLAs, and the tier structure
steps.r: Director Field Retail Operations / Store Ops

steps.activity: Staff & equip: staffing model from demand forecast, the SME/tier structure, the ticketing/CRM tool (distinct from VS-27 ITSM and VS-103 HR case), and training
steps.r: Director Field Retail Operations / HR / IT

steps.activity: Govern & launch: leadership sign-off (VS-36), the SLA/KPI baseline, the integration with field visits (W5114) and escalation (W5122), and go-live
steps.r: Director Field Retail Operations / VP Store Operations

fields.Owner: Store Support Center Lead / Director Field Retail Operations
fields.Participants: Store Managers (VS-07), Regional/District Managers, functional leads (Merch/IT/HR/Facilities/LP), CX (VS-13)
fields.Trigger: Store contact (hotline/chat/ticket); field escalation (W5118); system alert

workflows.name: Store Issue Intake, Triage, Resolution & Escalation Management

Automation Opportunity: - Auto-classification/routing; SLA-monitoring; recurring-issue detection; knowledge-base suggestion
Controls: - CTL-763 (ensure controlled execution — Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics (PA-177.3).)
- CTL-763: every issue logged & triaged; SLA monitored; root-cause captured for recurring issues (VS-133)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-103 (HR), VS-138 (facilities), VS-23 (LP), VS-133 (CI); W5121 (center), W5126 (knowledge), W5127 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Mis-routing risk**: Issue routed to wrong function → delay; mitigated by triage classification & routing rules
- **SLA-breach risk**: Slow resolution → store downtime/CX impact; mitigated by SLA monitoring + escalation
- **Recurrence risk**: Same issue repeated → no root-cause fix; mitigated by step-3 root-cause + CI (VS-133)
System Touchpoints: - Ticketing/case tool (W5121); knowledge base (W5126); functional systems (Merch VS-01 / IT VS-27 / HR VS-103 / Facilities VS-138 / LP VS-23); analytics (VS-28); CI (VS-133)

steps.activity: Intake & triage: log the issue (channel, category, store, severity), classify, route to the right tier/function (Merch/IT/HR/Facilities/LP), and set the SLA
steps.r: Support Center Agent

steps.activity: Resolve or escalate: tier-1 resolution (knowledge base W5126, policy clarification, routine exception), or escalate to tier-2 functional SME / Regional Manager / Director per the escalation matrix
steps.r: Support Center Agent / Functional SME / Regional Manager

steps.activity: Close & verify: confirm resolution with the store, capture the root-cause/lesson, feed recurring issues to CI (VS-133) and the knowledge base (W5126), and the SLA/quality reporting (W5120/W5127)
steps.r: Support Center Lead / Analytics

fields.Owner: Store Support Center Lead / Director Field Retail Operations
fields.Participants: Store Managers (VS-07), Regional/District Managers, Pricing (VS-01.2/VS-118), Finance (VS-17.4), Compliance (VS-22/VS-118), functional approvers
fields.Trigger: Store/field requests an exception to policy/standard (price override beyond limit, return-policy exception, markdown authorization, policy waiver, special-order approval)

workflows.name: Exception & Override Authorization Handling (Store→HQ Approval Workflow)

Automation Opportunity: - Exception-request workflow with auto-routing; SoD check; exception-volume/pattern analytics
Controls: - CTL-763 (ensure controlled execution — Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics (PA-177.3).)
- CTL-763: authorization matrix enforced; no self-approval (SoD); exceptions logged for audit (VS-21); volume monitored
Cross-references: - links to VS-08 (POS override), VS-118 (price integrity), VS-21 (audit), VS-22 (compliance), VS-133 (CI/policy review); W5121 (center), W5127 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Abuse risk**: Exceptions used to bypass controls (e.g. fake price overrides → shrink/leakage); mitigated by authorization matrix + SoD + analytics
- **Delay risk**: Slow exception approval → lost sale/customer; mitigated by SLA + tier structure
- **Policy-misfit risk**: High exception volume signals a broken policy; mitigated by exception-volume analytics → policy review (VS-133)
System Touchpoints: - Approval/workflow engine (links VS-15/VS-17 approval matrix); POS override (VS-08); pricing (VS-01.2/VS-118); audit log (VS-21); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Intake the exception request: the request type, business justification, the policy/standard being excepted, the $/margin/precedent impact, and the requesting store/manager
steps.r: Support Center Agent / Store Manager

steps.activity: Evaluate & authorize/deny: route to the approver per the exception-authorization matrix (dollar threshold, type, risk), the integrity/SoD check (no self-approval), and the compliance review where needed (VS-22/VS-118)
steps.r: Approver / Compliance / Director Field Retail Operations

steps.activity: Execute, log & monitor: execute the approved exception (system override), log for audit (VS-21), monitor exception-volume/spend analytics for abuse or policy-misfit, and feed policy review (VS-133)
steps.r: Support Center / Finance / Analytics

fields.Participants: Store staff (VS-19), Store Managers (VS-07), HR/HRBP (VS-103), Labor Relations (VS-84), Ethics (VS-119), Regional Managers
fields.Trigger: Store staff/manager grievance or concern; feedback submission

workflows.name: Store Grievance, Concern & Feedback Resolution Channel

Automation Opportunity: - Confidential grievance intake; classification/routing; anti-retaliation flagging; resolution SLA
Controls: - CTL-763 (ensure controlled execution — Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics (PA-177.3).)
- CTL-763: confidentiality & anti-retaliation (VS-119/VS-84); correct routing; resolution documented & fed back
Cross-references: - links to VS-84 (labor relations), VS-103 (HR), VS-119 (ethics/whistleblower), VS-24 (HSE); W5121 (center), W5127 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retaliation risk**: Reporter punished for raising concern → culture harm + legal (VS-84); mitigated by anti-retaliation protection
- **Mis-routing risk**: Grievance sent to operational channel when it needs HR/ethics; mitigated by classification + routing
- **Unaddressed risk**: Concerns logged but not resolved → disengagement; mitigated by resolution SLA + feedback
System Touchpoints: - Case/grievance tool (VS-103/VS-84); ethics line (VS-119); HSE (VS-24); CI (VS-133); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Receive & classify the grievance/concern: channel (support center, HRBP, ethics line VS-119), type (workplace/managerial/operational/policy/safety), severity, and the confidentiality/anti-retaliation flag
steps.r: Support Center / HRBP

steps.activity: Investigate & resolve (or route): operational concern → field-manager resolution; HR/labor → VS-84/VS-103; ethics/whistleblower → VS-119; safety → VS-24; with anti-retaliation protection
steps.r: Director Field Retail Operations / HRBP / Functional Lead

steps.activity: Close, document & feedback: resolution to the reporter, documentation, the systemic-fix where needed (VS-133), and the aggregated grievance analytics (W5127)
steps.r: HRBP / Analytics

fields.Owner: Store Support Center Lead / Director Field Retail Operations
fields.Participants: Merchandising (VS-01), IT (VS-27), HR (VS-103), Facilities (VS-138), LP (VS-23), Quality (VS-31), Recall (VS-89), functional leads
fields.Trigger: Multi-function store issue (e.g. product defect + recall, system outage + manual workaround, facility failure + safety, shrink ring + LP)

Automation Opportunity: - Multi-function case with linked sub-tasks; coordinator dashboard; handoff SLA tracking
Controls: - CTL-763 (ensure controlled execution — Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics (PA-177.3).)
- CTL-763: single accountable coordinator; linked sub-tasks per function; integrated-resolution confirmation
Cross-references: - links to VS-89 (recall), VS-27 (IT), VS-138 (facilities), VS-23 (LP), VS-31 (quality); W5122 (escalation), W5127 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Fragmentation risk**: Each function works its piece in silos → no integrated resolution; mitigated by single coordinator + linked sub-tickets
- **Dropped-handoff risk**: A function drops its piece → incomplete fix; mitigated by coordinator tracking
- **Slow-coordination risk**: Convening functions is slow → store impact; mitigated by defined coordination protocol + SLA
System Touchpoints: - Coordinated case/multi-sub-ticket tool; functional systems (VS-01/VS-27/VS-103/VS-138/VS-23/VS-89); CI (VS-133); analytics (VS-28)

steps.activity: Convene the cross-functional case: identify the functions involved, open a coordinated case (single ticket linking sub-tasks per function), and assign a single accountable coordinator
steps.r: Support Center Lead / Director Field Retail Operations

steps.activity: Coordinate execution: each function executes its piece (Merch recall/return VS-89, IT fix VS-27, HR staffing VS-103, Facilities repair VS-138, LP investigation VS-23), with the coordinator tracking the integrated resolution
steps.r: Functional Leads / Coordinator

steps.activity: Close, debrief & systemize: confirm integrated resolution to the store, debrief the cross-functional case for systemic-fix (VS-133), and feed the coordination-effectiveness analytics (W5127)
steps.r: Coordinator / Analytics

fields.Owner: Director Field Retail Operations / Knowledge Mgmt (VS-30.3)
fields.Participants: Store Ops (VS-07), functional SMEs, Knowledge Mgmt (VS-30.3), L&D (VS-19.4), IT (VS-27)

workflows.name: Store Knowledge Base, SOP Support & Field Self-Service Enablement

Automation Opportunity: - Searchable KB with article-usefulness scoring; deflection analytics; gap auto-detection
Controls: - CTL-763 (ensure controlled execution — Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics (PA-177.3).)
- CTL-763: KB content owned & refreshed; source-of-truth governed (VS-88); deflection measured
Cross-references: - links to VS-30.3 (knowledge mgmt), VS-88 (records/SOP), VS-19.4 (L&D); W5121 (center), W5122 (issues), W5127 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stale-content risk**: Outdated SOPs → wrong guidance; mitigated by refresh cycle & ownership
- **Low-adoption risk**: Stores don't use the KB → no deflection; mitigated by UX + integration + awareness
- **Fragmentation risk**: KB separate from SOP/records systems; mitigated by integration with VS-88/VS-30.3
System Touchpoints: - Knowledge base (links VS-30.3/VS-88); support-center tool (W5121); L&D/LMS (VS-19.4); analytics (VS-28); CI (VS-133)

steps.activity: Build & maintain the knowledge base: SOPs, policy clarifications, FAQ, how-to/job-aids for recurring store issues, and the source-of-truth governance (links VS-88 records / VS-30.3 knowledge)
steps.r: SMEs / Knowledge Mgmt / Director Field Retail Operations

steps.activity: Enable field self-service: searchable knowledge base at the store/field, the deflection target (issues resolved without a ticket), and integration with the support-center tool (W5121) & L&D (VS-19.4)
steps.r: IT / Knowledge Mgmt / Director Field Retail Operations

steps.activity: Measure & improve: deflection rate, KB-article usefulness, gap-detection (issues with no article), and the refresh cycle (VS-133)
steps.r: Analytics / Knowledge Mgmt

fields.Participants: Analytics (VS-28), Store Ops (VS-07), Strategy (VS-33), Finance FP&A (VS-17.4), CX (VS-13), LP (VS-23)

workflows.name: Field & Store Operations Performance Dashboard & Comp-Store Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time field dashboard; auto outlier-detection; comp-store cohort engine
Controls: - CTL-763 (ensure controlled execution — Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics (PA-177.3).)
- CTL-763: data governed (VS-28.2); curated scorecard; outliers actioned; executive review (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (analytics), VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-33 (strategy), VS-13 (CX), VS-23 (shrink); W5109 (grading), W5114 (standards), W5120 (coaching analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Data-quality risk**: Stale/inaccurate data → wrong decisions; mitigated by governed data pipeline (VS-28.2)
- **Metric-overload risk**: Too many metrics → no focus; mitigated by curated scorecard
- **Inaction risk**: Dashboard without action → no improvement; mitigated by step-3 action assignment
System Touchpoints: - BI/analytics (VS-28); FP&A (VS-17.4); CX (VS-13); shrink (VS-23); standards (W5114); field systems (W5121/W5118); strategy scorecard (VS-33)

steps.activity: Build & maintain the field dashboard: per-store, per-manager, per-region/district roll-up of sales, comp-sales, margin, shrink (VS-23), CX (VS-13), standards-compliance (W5114), inventory turn, visit-cadence adherence, action-item closure, and support-center SLA
steps.r: Analytics / Director Field Retail Operations

steps.activity: Run comp-store & benchmark analytics: comparable-store sales (new/excluded stores), peer/region benchmark ranking (W5109), the cohort/maturity view, and the outlier/detection signals
steps.r: Analytics / Strategy / Director Field Retail Operations

steps.activity: Distribute & drive action: leadership/field distribution, drill-down investigation of outliers, action assignment (W5118/W5111), and the executive review (VS-33/VS-36)
steps.r: Analytics / Director Field Retail Operations / VP Store Operations

fields.Participants: OpEx (VS-133), Strategy (VS-33), Analytics (VS-28), Store Ops (VS-07), HR (VS-103), Finance (VS-17.4)

workflows.name: Field Retail Operations Continuous Improvement, Benchmarking & Program Review

Automation Opportunity: - Benchmark data-feed; program-ROI model; CI action tracker (VS-133)
Controls: - CTL-763 (ensure controlled execution — Store Support Center, Escalation & Field Operations Analytics (PA-177.3).)
- CTL-763: program reviewed vs KPIs; benchmark contextualized; change OCM-managed (VS-134); leadership-approved (VS-36)
Cross-references: - links to VS-133 (OpEx/CI), VS-33 (strategy), VS-134 (OCM), VS-36 (governance); W5105 (strategy/model), W5127 (dashboard), W5120 (analytics)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stasis risk**: Field model unchanged despite changing retail landscape; mitigated by annual re-plan + benchmarking
- **Benchmark-misfit risk**: Copying benchmarks not suited to PH provincial big-box; mitigated by contextual judgment
- **Change-failure risk**: Field-model change resisted; mitigated by OCM (VS-134)
System Touchpoints: - CI (VS-133); analytics (VS-28); strategy (VS-33); OCM (VS-134); governance (VS-36); field dashboard (W5127)

steps.a: Director Field Retail Operations / VP Store Operations
steps.activity: Run the program review: field-program performance vs KPIs (W5105), the field-cost-to-serve, the visit/coaching ROI, and the field-org effectiveness
steps.r: Director Field Retail Operations / Analytics / OpEx

steps.activity: Benchmark externally: retail field-ops benchmarks (span-of-control, visit frequency, comp-sales lift from field execution), peer/industry comparison, and the gap-to-best-practice
steps.r: Strategy / OpEx / Director Field Retail Operations

steps.activity: Improve & re-plan: improvement actions (VS-133), the field-model re-plan (W5105), the OCM for field change (VS-134), and the leadership sign-off (VS-36)
steps.r: Director Field Retail Operations / OpEx / OCM
